input: Schedule a termite bond renewal with the exterminator

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing the renewal deadline or expiration date determines urgency and whether the appointment needs to be rushed or can be scheduled casually.
Whether the user already has an exterminator company in mind or needs to find/compare one changes the first steps entirely.
Knowing how the user needs to contact the exterminator (call, online portal, email) determines the immediate next action to take.
Whether this is a simple renewal of an existing bond or requires a new inspection/treatment affects how much time and coordination is involved.
The type of property (single-family home, rental, condo) and its location can affect availability, pricing, and what the bond covers.
The user's preferred appointment window (weekday, weekend, morning, afternoon) directly affects which time slots to request when booking.
Understanding what the user considers this task complete — confirmed appointment only, or also having paperwork/documentation in hand — shapes how far the plan needs to go.

gold.taskTitle: Schedule termite bond renewal with exterminator
gold.taskDescription: The user needs to arrange a termite bond renewal appointment with their exterminator company.

questions.title: When does your current termite bond expire?
questions.description: Identify the expiration or renewal deadline date to determine how urgently the appointment needs to be scheduled.

questions.title: Do you already have an exterminator company to call?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has an existing relationship with a specific exterminator or needs to find one first.

questions.title: How do you typically reach your exterminator to book?
questions.description: Clarify the contact method — phone call, online portal, email, or app — to identify the immediate first action.

questions.title: Does the renewal require a new inspection or treatment?
questions.description: Understand whether this is an administrative renewal or whether a technician visit with inspection or treatment is also required.

questions.title: What type of property is the bond being renewed for?
questions.description: Know whether this is for a primary residence, rental property, or commercial space, as this can affect scheduling and coverage.

questions.title: What days or times work best for your appointment?
questions.description: Capture the user's scheduling preferences — weekday vs. weekend, morning vs. afternoon — to use when booking.

questions.title: What does done look like — booked, or paperwork received too?
questions.description: Determine whether the task is complete once the appointment is confirmed, or if it also includes receiving and filing the renewed bond documentation.
